integrity: Combinatorial all-order proof is included; finite direct and transfer checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary labelled simple cycles C_n for n>=3; exactly one of colors 1,2 per selected vertex. Not the set-valued classical or independent-rainbow versions; does not count orbits. Full text of Chellali–Haynes–Hedetniemi (2026) unavailable; historical priority provisional.
title: A matching-polynomial identity for singleton two-rainbow domination on cycles
